Method of Attack: Exploits a remote file inclusion (RFI) vulnerability in AVTech device firmware to download malware binary
Gathers info on infected device, sends it to remote server, launches DDoS attacks on demand
Allows botnet operator to clean device and remove malware
Attack Vector: Remote file inclusion (RFI) triggered by accessing a CGI script in AVTech Cloud service firmware
Indicators of Compromise: Malware binary downloaded from three IPs registered to a South Korean ISP
